Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the proposal. We want to include both our VP of Product (Samir Patel) and our CIO (Kiran Rao) on the demo, but their calendars are tight this week. Kiran is only available in the afternoon Pacific, while Samir is only free early mornings Pacific.

Can you suggest a couple of windows where your exec can join for a 45-minute walkthrough? If necessary we can run a short 20-minute VP-level executive highlight followed by a longer technical deep-dive with our CIO and engineering team. Also, we prefer to have the session recorded for internal review — will that be OK?

I've attached the signed NDA and a short note on our security contact.

Appreciate your help — we want to get this on the calendar this month.

Best,
Ava

Hi Ava — thanks for sending the NDA and the availability notes. Recording is fine — we can record the high-level session and the technical deep-dive as separate files if that helps with internal distribution.

Quick proposal:
- Option A: 45-minute executive-focused session (VP + Samir) — Tue 2026-10-13 08:00-08:45 PT — followed at 11:00 PT by a 60-minute technical deep-dive for the CIO/engineering team (optional attendance for execs).
- Option B: Single 60-minute session that starts at 09:30 PT on Thu 2026-10-15 (we lead with a 20-minute exec summary then transition into the technical demo).

Ben is looped in to help with calendar coordination — he can send invites that include separate calendar items for the exec highlight and the technical run-through. Marissa will join the exec summary to cover product fit and ROI briefly.

Please let us know which option works better and whether Kiran needs the technical agenda in advance (we can share a short one-pager).

Best,

Elliot / Ava — thanks. Option B (single 60-minute block) is preferable for my schedule; starting with an executive 20-minute summary is ideal. If you can share the technical agenda + any pre-read for our security team that would speed review.

Also, please include our security contact (sec-eval@noventis.com) on any artifact links.

—Kiran
